claims.claim: Arrived Queenstown (about ten o'clock this morning)
claims.citation: New York Herald, 23 May 1866, p. 11, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
was towed into this port about ten o'clock this morning by
the City of Cork, another steamer owned by the same com-
pany.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 24 May 1866, p. 5, col. 6
claims.verbatim:
City of Cork (s), Bridgman, and City of Washington (s),
Haskell, do;

claims.citation: The Express (London), 7 May 1866, HMD item art0012 (Heritage Made Digital, British Library)

claims.claim: Spoken / sighted Fastnet 260 miles from Fastnet (4th inst)
claims.citation: New York Herald, 14 May 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship City of Paris (Br). Kennedy, Liverpool and
Queenstown May 3, 5 PM, with mdse and passengers, to J G
Dale. 4th inst, 260 miles from Fastnet, saw and laid by
steamship City of Washington, in tow of steamship City of
Cork; 12th, lat 40 40, lon 67 45, passed ship Escort, from Liv-
erpool for New York; same day, 210 miles from Sandy Hook,
steamship Minnehaha (Br), bound W.
